Previous experience providing administrative support within a complex office or academic environment.
Experience working in higher education, research development, or managing multi-institute administrative workflows.

Plan, manage, and evaluate research-related events, site visits, and Engineering Center reviews, including agenda setting, venue sourcing, speaker coordination, travel arrangements, and reimbursement processing.
Maintain and update web content for the Research Development office and the three Engineering+ Institutes to ensure accurate, timely information.
Collect, compile, and analyze data from multiple sources to maintain departmental records and prepare draft reports.
Apply organization policies to oversee day-to-day administrative operations and resolve operational issues of moderate scope.
Proficiency with website content updates and data compilation/analysis software (e.g., Excel, CMS platforms).
Strong organizational and event planning skills with the ability to manage time-sensitive duties and shifting priorities.
Familiarity with institutional travel processes, reimbursement policies, and financial record-keeping.
Effective written and interpersonal communication skills to interact with faculty, guest speakers, and leadership.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
